result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#1、#3）都已進 moat.threats，並進 R3 與 triggers n7；customer_second_source 與 customer_concentration_credit 在證據包的負向子集中沒有條目。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots[0]","reason":"supply_demand_durability#1（Lifecycle Services −9%、ARR 下調）已寫進最大風險盲點、R1／R4 與 single_thing，並已化為 30% 空頭機率與 FY2028 EPS 12.8 的情境。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"reg_tariff_export#1／#3、geo_supply_chain#2、substitute_technology#0／#1 都已被 contradictions、R5、triggers n5／n6／n7 接住，沒有 finding 無人接。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"wait_for_price=true，等待條件為 ≤340 美元且共識 ≥14.50，具體可驗；裁決觀望是 row 8w 的規則結果，不與 market_wrong_reason_given=false 矛盾，q5 也明說不主張市場低估。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots","reason":"regulatory_antitrust 三組查詢切題（反壟斷、DOJ／FTC／EU），但判斷沒有明寫該軸無證據對結論的影響；屬尾部風險，不擋，燈號由程式覆寫。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"reinvest_rate 有算式可複算（383÷1,752≈21.9%）；endo_ceiling 4.5% 低於共識 CAGR 11.25%，已在 q3 歸因（缺口來自漲價、利潤率與回購）；Bull 26.6／Base 21.2／Bear 16.0 價差實質；bull 744.8、bear 272、EV +32.2%、IRR 6.2% 都與 scenario_meta 對得上；roiic 用 ROIC 代理已揭露，不算實質缺陷。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business","reason":"引用的營運指標都是 Q4 FY2026（2026-11-05 公告）；decision_inputs 沒有 consensus_rev_3m_pct；12.86% 的「上修」已明確判為財年換年並寫出可能看錯之處，沒有當唯一依據。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions[4]","reason":"前份非空的 drift 欄位（signal、val、ma、trap、price_at_dd）都有映射，但 val 🟠→🟡 標成純「價格變動」，ruling 卻自述「前份倍數假設已失效、基準改用倍數下降」，這是核心假設與情境方法變更被併入價格原因，歸因需改標；因為價格效果另有程式拆解且裁決方向未變，不到 🔴。"}]
